required_before_activation: Verify the archive and every extracted allowlist member before atomic activation; reject every unlisted archive entry.
Install the archive MIT license and ThirdPartyNotices.txt alongside the runtime and reconcile both in the optional-pack SBOM.
Complete human legal review of the official archive ThirdPartyNotices terms before optional-runtime redistribution or activation.
Run static ONNX admission and the attested current-device self-test before first session creation.
Require a signed current-device measured resource envelope and whole-loadout admission.
notes: This record is canonical optional-download coverage; the strict OpenSeeFace v2 pack manifest carries the same archive binding.
